comment: Multi-source SCRIPT card fixture (M1, docs/decisions/2026-11-20-card-multi-input-and-wire-gesture.md §四). One card, three ports, three DIFFERENT upstream matrices — the case the frontend store could not express before the port actions existed. It has two halves that must agree: `ports` describes the card side (`inputs[]` + `params.portNames`), `wire` describes what the backend is told (positional `portId`/`varName`/`mode`/`source`). `web/tests/ScriptCardStore.test.ts` builds the card through the real store actions and compares BOTH halves against the live state, so a rule that drifts on either side of the wire fails here instead of in production. NOTE: ctest's `card_fixtures` runner lists `function-card.v2.json` explicitly, so this file is not (yet) read by the C++ side; a `builtin:python` case cannot go through `NodeRegistry` there without a pinned Python runtime, and the multi-port builtin case (`builtin:linear-regression`, x<-m7 y<-m8) is already covered by that file.
